name: templates-saas-landing-page
title: SaaS Landing Page
description: A starting-point marketing landing page example built with Tailwind CSS, combining a header, hero, stats, features, pricing, and footer into a single page. Not a production-ready template.
useWhen: Starting a SaaS marketing page with a coherent header, hero, proof points, features, pricing, and footer.
Prototyping a product landing page before replacing placeholder copy and imagery with real product material.
avoidWhen: Publishing without brand-specific copy, legal links, analytics, and real conversion destinations.
Building an authenticated application screen or dashboard.
responsiveBehavior: Hero and feature layouts stack on small screens; header navigation becomes a labelled mobile menu; pricing cards and logo rows reflow without horizontal clipping.
accessibility: Use one clear page h1 and a logical heading hierarchy throughout sections.
Ensure every CTA names its destination or action, and mark decorative images with empty alt text.
